title: A Ship Was Found With Nobody On Board 🚢 What Happened? #shorts
description:
December 1872: the Mary Celeste is found sailing between the Azores and Portugal with nobody aboard. Six months of food and water untouched. 1,701 barrels of alcohol — nine of them empty. The lifeboat gone, and all ten people with it.

What's your verdict? A) pirates B) fumes from the cargo C) a waterspout — comment below 👇

Animated, voiced and scored in code. Narration is a synthetic (text-to-speech) voice.

title: Two Princes Walked Into the Tower of London. They Never Walked Out. #shorts
description:
1483: Edward V, 12, and his brother Richard, 9, are lodged in the Tower of London and never seen again. Their uncle takes the crown as Richard III. In 1674, workers find two small skeletons under a staircase.

Who did it? A) Richard III B) Henry Tudor C) nobody — they escaped. Comment your verdict 👇

title: 100+ Colonists Vanished. They Left Behind One Word. #shorts
description:
1590: John White returns to the Roanoke colony to find more than 100 settlers gone — including his granddaughter, Virginia Dare. No bodies, no graves. Just one word carved into a post: CROATOAN.

Where did they go? A) joined the Croatoan people B) lost at sea C) moved inland. Comment your verdict 👇

title: 9 Hikers, One Tent Cut From the Inside. What Happened? #shorts
description:
February 1959: nine hikers die on a mountain in the northern Urals. Their tent was cut open from the inside; they fled into around −30°C, most without shoes. Some had broken ribs and skull fractures but no sign of a fight. (A 2021 study in Communications Earth & Environment argued for a small slab avalanche.)

What happened? A) avalanche B) secret weapons test C) something else. Comment your verdict 👇
